svg.title: How vm-tuneup-morpheus-plugin works
svg.desc: Architecture and request flows of vm-tuneup-morpheus-plugin: the browser, the plugin inside the Morpheus appliance, and the HVM VMs it audits.
svg.text: We've migrated to HVM. Now what? A read-only audit of HVM VMs, inside Morpheus: what the migration left behind, and what to tune next.

Answered or No answer, and when, is shown
Install, scan, plan, uninstall. The plugin has no settings and no schedules: scans run only when someone opens a tab or runs the report. It never changes a VM, host or cluster.
Every finding says what happens if you leave it and what fixing it costs (downtime, risk, whether it can be undone, what to do first), and is either a Recommendation (doable in
the Morpheus UI or inside the guest OS) or a Consideration (needs host-level work; never recommended).
